name: Amen Packaging Inc
old_description: Amen Packaging  has been defining packaging excellence since 1979.  Spanning multiple industries, we provide quality design, implementation and delivery of package and container solutions.
about:
Amen Packaging Inc has operated from Denver, Colorado since its founding in 1979. The company began in a modest location beneath a busy highway and has remained in central Denver through its growth. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed beyond its status as a small business and a Denver Broncos Small Business Partner.

As a wholesale distributor, Amen Packaging supplies packaging containers including Boston rounds, amber glass bottles, woozy bottles, jars, cans, and pails. The firm also offers packaging design, container printing, consultation, and turnkey packaging selection services. It provides options for hazardous materials and export shipping compliance. No facility size, headcount, or volume metrics are published.

The distributor serves the paint and coatings, food and co-packing, chemical, industrial, cosmetic, wine and spirits, and health and pharmaceutical sectors. Customers range from industrial manufacturers to co-packers and brand owners seeking regulatory-compliant packaging.

Amen Packaging emphasizes its 45-plus years of regional experience and its ability to deliver complete turnkey packaging solutions backed by consultation. The company highlights its Denver Broncos Small Business Partner designation and a $200 minimum order threshold for wholesale transactions.

name: America Wood Solutions
old_description: Serving homeowners, contractors, and hospitality teams with precision cabinetry, CNC-driven millwork, and reliable project execution.
about:
America Wood Solutions operates from Streamwood, Illinois, where it was founded in 1996 as a family-owned, locally operated woodworking shop. The company began with a focus on custom cabinetry and has since expanded its capabilities to serve a broader range of millwork needs.

The shop produces custom cabinetry, architectural casework, and millwork for residential, commercial, and hospitality projects. Its capabilities include CNC-driven machining, plastic laminate fabrication, and full project execution from design through installation. The team reports more than 1,000 completed projects over three decades, though facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Clients include hotel groups and property managers seeking brand-consistent casework for guest rooms, public areas, and front desks; commercial contractors outfitting offices, barbershops, salons, and retail interiors; and homeowners commissioning custom kitchens, bathrooms, built-ins, and storage systems. The company also works with general contractors who rely on its ability to meet tight schedules and specifications.

America Wood Solutions emphasizes precision, durability, and long-term performance over initial appearance. Its stated approach centers on understanding scope, building to spec with consistency, communicating clearly, and delivering work that holds up over time. The business was built on the belief that quality craftsmanship is measured by how it performs years after installation.

name: American Cable & Electronics, inc
old_description: Manufacturer of Custom Cables and Cable Assemblies for the OEM Market
about:
American Cable & Electronics, Inc. operates from Menomonee Falls, Wisconsin, where it manufactures custom cable assemblies and electro-mechanical assemblies for original equipment manufacturers.

The company specializes in engineering, rapid prototyping, and low-volume production of complex electromechanical assemblies. Its capabilities span simple wire harnesses to finished assemblies that integrate plastics, sheet metal, electronics, cable assemblies, and plastic-injected overmolded parts. Services include low-volume overmolding with flexible tooling, custom cable assemblies, D-sub and BNC connector assemblies, high-definition video and data-center cables, embedded circuits, overmolded PCBs, and turnkey electro-mechanical projects.

Its customer base includes OEMs in medical electronics, industrial controls, and commercial products, as well as the U.S. and Canadian departments of defense. The firm is a Tier 1 supplier to the medical industry and holds registrations for defense work.

ACE differentiates itself through a focus on low-volume manufacturing excellence, emphasizing attention to detail, communication across staff and suppliers, and process controls designed to ensure first-time quality. Engineering support covers design for manufacturability, design assistance, material analysis and testing, tooling development, and CAD services, backed by a global procurement strategy aimed at on-time delivery.

name: American Cable Products LLC
old_description: Delivering excellence in communication connectivity since 2002
about:
American Cable Products, LLC was established in November 2002 in Lake St Louis, Missouri. The minority-owned business (MBE certified) began as a provider of low‑voltage communication connectivity solutions, aiming to serve organizations across the United States, Canada, Mexico, and U.S. territories.

The company delivers end‑to‑end infrastructure services divided into inside‑plant and outside‑plant work. Inside‑plant capabilities include structured premise cabling (Cat5e, Cat6, Cat6a, and fiber), data‑center design and implementation, hardware configuration, and network infrastructure. Outside‑plant services cover provider connection points, fiber‑optic installations, campus connectivity, and inter‑building links. A security and surveillance division installs IP camera systems, access‑control and biometric solutions, with project experience exceeding 2,800 cameras. The firm also provides wireless networks, VoIP, audio‑visual, SCADA/industrial IoT, satellite communications, consulting, and ongoing maintenance. Operations span all 50 states, with regional offices supporting a project portfolio that includes 500‑plus facilities and 1,000‑plus sites.

Clients range from Fortune 500 enterprises to critical‑infrastructure operators in sectors such as data centers, healthcare, corrections, education, airports, government, retail, and manufacturing. Named references include St. Louis Lambert International Airport, a multi‑site healthcare network, a university system, a retail distribution chain, and an industrial manufacturing complex.

American Cable Products states its mission is to be a one‑stop shop for communication connectivity from the provider demarcation point to the client data center, delivering practical, high‑quality, and cost‑effective IT installation and service while exceeding customer expectations. Core values cited are quality, reliability, customer focus, and cost effectiveness.

name: American Circuits
old_description: American Circuits is an electronic contract manufacturer headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, providing turnkey printed circuit board assembly across two Charlotte facilities.
about:
American Circuits operates from Charlotte, North Carolina, where it has maintained a family-run, minority-owned contract manufacturing business for over 30 years. The company was founded by Vic Gondha, a first-generation immigrant who built the firm after arriving in the United States with a goal of owning a business. His son, Ket Gondha, now serves as CEO, having expanded the campus to two facilities totaling roughly 40,000 square feet.

The company provides turnkey printed circuit board assembly from bare-board fabrication through final box-build integration. Its services span SMT, through-hole, and mixed-technology assembly, rapid prototyping, conformal coating and potting, automated optical inspection, PCB design and reverse engineering, design-for-manufacturability analysis, BOM optimization, custom wire-harness and cable assembly, and full electro-mechanical integration. Production runs range from single prototypes to volumes exceeding 100,000 units.

American Circuits serves approximately 400 customers across defense, healthcare, robotics, and LED-lighting sectors. Named clients include TE Connectivity, Honda, and Assa Abloy, the latter a Charlotte-based security and access-control manufacturer.

The firm distinguishes itself by controlling the entire process from bare-board supply to finished assembly, a combination it says few competitors offer. It emphasizes U.S.-based manufacturing, engineering support at every stage, flexible production runs, and rapid turnarounds. The operation is ISO 9001 certified, ITAR registered, UL recognized, and compliant with RoHS, REACH, and Dodd-Frank conflict-mineral requirements.

name: American Control Electronics
old_description: Displays, Enclosures, Graphics, Labels, Sensors, Connectivity
about:
American Control Electronics (ACE) operates from South Beloit, Illinois, with a second facility in Chanhassen, Minnesota. The company is part of the Global Point Technologies Group and traces its roots back more than six decades in motor control design and manufacturing, though a specific founding year is not publicly stated.

ACE manufactures electronic motor controls, power products, and custom electronic assemblies. Its capabilities span custom circuit design, PCB layout and assembly, electronic contract manufacturing, UL508A control panel assembly, wire harness and box build, as well as testing and compliance support. The Chanhassen site runs an ISO 9001:2015-certified quality system, while the South Beloit plant handles UL508A panel assembly and in-house UL testing via the UL Data Acceptance Program.

The company serves OEMs across industrial, food processing, medical, automotive, agriculture, scientific, oil and gas, and sports markets, among others. It also supports home automation and commercial facility systems through its motor control product lines.

ACE emphasizes its 60-plus years of experience and its integration within the Global Point Technologies network, which provides manufacturing intelligence across the Americas and Asia. The firm also highlights flexible circuit technologies through its GOT Interface brand, enabling lightweight, adaptable interfaces for medical, industrial, and IoT applications.

name: American Electric Components, Inc.
old_description: Manufactures and repairs electrical transformers (single/three-phase, up to 10,000 KVA)
about:
American Electric Components, Inc. was founded in 1995 in Vernon, California, as a family-owned and operated business. The company traces its roots to a multi-generational team that brings over a century of cumulative experience to the design, fabrication, and repair of electrical transformers.

Operating from a 78,400-square-foot property with a 47,000-square-foot shop, AEC maintains complete in-house control over manufacturing, from initial engineering through final testing. The facility produces and refurbishes single- and three-phase dry-type and oil-filled transformers rated up to 10,000 kVA and 69,000 volts, along with reactors, padmounts, saturable current transformers, inverter-duty units, and desalter transformers. A large stock of new, rebuilt, and repaired units is kept on hand for immediate sale or rental.

The company serves utility, industrial, commercial, and desalination customers nationwide. It is a certified repair center for both ABB and General Electric, meaning its technicians are factory-trained and its processes follow original equipment manufacturer standards. Clients range from utilities needing rapid replacement units to industrial plants requiring on-site oil leak repair, electrical testing, and preventive maintenance.

AEC emphasizes end-to-end oversight of the production cycle, adherence to NEMA, ANSI, IEEE, and UL standards, and the ability to deploy field service crews for emergency repairs. The combination of a deep inventory, certified OEM repair credentials, and a legacy of family stewardship is presented as the foundation of its reliability.

name: American Home Medical Equipment Co
old_description: We carry an extensive selection of respiratory equipment to aid in breathing as well as CPAP and BIPAP supplies for sufferers of sleep apnea.
about:
American Home Medical Equipment Co operates from Lemoyne, Pennsylvania, and was founded in 2011. The company is led by CEO John D. Gilbert and CFO Teresa Gilbert.

The firm supplies home medical equipment across Central Pennsylvania, focusing on respiratory devices such as CPAP and BiPAP machines for sleep apnea, mobility assistance products, and seated lift chairs for joint and back pain. It maintains a showroom and offers delivery services, in-home setup, and financing through Members First on select showroom items.

Customers include individuals with respiratory conditions, sleep apnea sufferers, and those needing mobility aids. The company serves the home medical equipment, respiratory care, and durable medical equipment sectors, primarily in the Central Pennsylvania region.

Its stated mission emphasizes personalized, dignified, educational, and compassionate care combined with current technology. The company highlights its blend of small-town service and modern technology, community involvement, and assistance with funding for customers.

name: American Howa Kentucky, Inc. Georgetown Plant
old_description: With 33 manufacturing and R&D facilities in over a dozen countries worldwide, HOWA is able to meet our customers’ diverse needs on a global scale, while simultaneously responding to the unique demands of our local clientele.
about:
American Howa Kentucky, Inc. Georgetown Plant (AHK-GT) is located in Midway, Kentucky. The facility was established in 2017 as part of the North American expansion of HOWA USA Holdings, Inc., which traces its U.S. presence to a 2004 plant in Indiana. The Georgetown plant operates as a subsidiary of the global HOWA network, which comprises 33 manufacturing and R&D sites across more than a dozen countries.

The plant produces automotive interior components, including headliners, sunshades, dash insulators, felt products, and polyurethane foam parts. Production capabilities include felt manufacturing, PU foam processing (with two foam lines), and on-site headliner assembly. The facility supports programs for multiple automakers, though specific facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed.

The Georgetown plant serves the automotive industry, supplying Tier 1 and OEM customers. Its client list includes Nissan North America (for the Leaf, Murano, Titan, and Frontier), Toyota Motor North America, American Honda Motor Co., Aisin World Corp. of America, and Webasto Product North America.

The company's stated mission emphasizes employee well-being, unique product development through boldness and creativity, environmental conservation, continuous improvement for customer satisfaction, and contribution to local development. The Georgetown plant was added to expand capacity for PU foam and headliner production in support of growing North American demand.

Two dedicated PU foam production lines
Global network of 33 manufacturing and R&D facilities
